description: This Java class `ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory` provides functionality for parsing complex JSON field selector strings, decoding URL-encoded parts, handling nested parentheses, and producing an immutable JSON field selector object with a set of JSON pointers. It supports constructing instances via static factory methods, validating syntax, and splitting the selector string into hierarchical JSON pointers.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating `JsonFieldSelector` instances from complex string representations, capable of parsing nested and URL-encoded JSON field selectors.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance from a URL-encoded or plain JSON field selector string, decoding if necessary, with provided JSON parse options.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Generates a `JsonFieldSelector` object based on the parsed and processed selector string, producing a set of JSON pointers.
